title: Critz: Tycoon — A Tiny World
status: Awaiting listening review; not integrated into gameplay

tracks.title: A Tiny World, A New Beginning
tracks.story: The title theme: one small act of care opens into a whole world.

tracks.title: Kitchen Light, Still On
tracks.story: A familiar light under the door; tenderness and room to begin again.

tracks.title: Pebble in a Pocket
tracks.story: A gecko peeks out, freezes, then decides your sleeve is home.

tracks.title: Kaid Brought Tomorrow
tracks.story: A 25-gallon gift arrives; the tune starts alone and gains an answering friend.

tracks.title: Rootport Wakes Up
tracks.story: Shutters open, neighbors wave, and the town finds its walking rhythm.

tracks.title: Past the Last Mailbox
tracks.story: The first forest path feels enormous; a skipping tune grows into a confident stride.

tracks.title: Notebook Full of Wings
tracks.story: Professor Nugget helps turn a puzzling movement into a first field-note sketch.

tracks.title: Button Takes the Scenic Route
tracks.story: A snail makes a mighty expedition across one leaf.

tracks.title: Glow n’ Blow
tracks.story: Glass catches amber light; playful bubbles trade places with a warm workshop groove.

tracks.title: A Rival, Not an Enemy
tracks.story: A friendly competitor strides ahead, then leaves space for you to catch up.

tracks.title: Rain Between the Houses
tracks.story: Rain blurs the streetlights; a small falling phrase slowly learns to rise.

tracks.title: Every Little Life Is Still Here
tracks.story: The hidden animals are safe. Sparse worry gives way to a gentle, breathing refrain.

tracks.title: Under the Floorboards
tracks.story: A harmless shadow seems enormous in the dark; listening replaces panic.

tracks.title: The Water Is Rising
tracks.story: Quick decisions protect the habitat; an uneven pulse steadies as help arrives.

tracks.title: Small Paws, Big Courage
tracks.story: An imagined friendly challenge: springy bass, quick feints, and a bright heroic answer.

tracks.title: No One Gets Left Behind
tracks.story: The rescue reaches its hardest moment; a nervous ostinato becomes collective courage.

tracks.title: We Did It, Together
tracks.story: The work is done, the animals are safe, and every answering voice gets a moment.

tracks.title: Sorry Is a Beginning
tracks.story: Mom and Hero share a quiet moment of care; an unresolved line finds a gentle answer.

tracks.title: New Leaves After Rain
tracks.story: Care becomes routine again; the same few hopeful notes return with stronger roots.

tracks.title: Little Root, Living Universe
tracks.story: Inside the terrarium, tiny independent patterns turn into one balanced ecosystem.

tracks.title: Midnight Tank Watch
tracks.story: The room is asleep; the tank light turns small movements into constellations.

tracks.title: Critter, One Little Heart
tracks.story: The first kind response to a tank photo becomes a tiny dance around the room.

tracks.title: Paper Boats to Liarsville
tracks.story: A daydream of the neighboring town, carried by water and an unhurried melody.

tracks.title: Bicycle Basket Sky
tracks.story: A future ride imagined with wind in your sleeves and nowhere urgent to be.

tracks.title: Footprints Where Nobody Went
tracks.story: An imagined cave trail: an odd meter asks a question that never quite repeats.

tracks.title: Snow Globe Promise
tracks.story: A winter daydream: bright specks of snow, warm hands, and a promise to return.

tracks.title: Salt Air, No Hurry
tracks.story: A beach daydream with soft syncopation; the tide leaves enough space to breathe.

tracks.title: Porch Radio, Summer 2004
tracks.story: An imagined old radio plays while afternoon shadows lengthen across the porch.

tracks.title: Fireflies Above the Filter
tracks.story: Little lights answer each other; the day ends without needing one more achievement.

tracks.title: Tomorrow Has Your Name
tracks.story: The album closes on a new melody that welcomes the title motif home, with friends answering.
